interest: Shows occupation controls suspending Yokohama Nursery's seed trade and an Egyptian request for Japanese rice seed.
keywords: Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers
overview: File 894.613 (1946-47): a U.S. nurseryman seeks pre-war seed imports from Yokohama Nursery Co.; State explains private trade is barred, directing him to the U.S. Commercial Company under SCAP; Cairo forwards Egypt's request for Japanese rice seed samples.

people.name: Roswell H. Whitman
people.role: Acting Chief, Japanese and Korean Affairs Division, Department of State

people.name: W. M. Brown
people.role: Drafter, Division of Japanese and Korean Affairs, Department of State

people.name: R. B. Elwood
people.role: Drafter / Foreign Service Officer, American Embassy, Cairo

subfiles.about: The Department of State explains restrictions barring private trade with occupied Japan and advises an American nurseryman to submit seed import requests through the U.S. Commercial Company.
subfiles.from: Roswell H. Whitman, Acting Chief, Japanese and Korean Affairs Division, Department of State
keywords: Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers
subfiles.summary: Whitman tells Hankele that private trade with Japan is barred under occupation rules, and the U.S. Commercial Company handles imports and can check seed availability with MacArthur's headquarters.
subfiles.title: Letter from Roswell H. Whitman to Allen J. Hankel regarding seed procurement from Japan
subfiles.to: Allen J. Hankel, Proprietor, Alanwold Nursery

subfiles.about: An American nurseryman requests guidance from the Department of State on how to send a commercial order for seeds to the Yokohama Nursery Company in post-war Japan.
subfiles.from: Allen J. Hankele, Proprietor, Alanwold Nursery
subfiles.summary: Hankele of Alanwold Nursery asks State for a permissible way to order seeds from Yokohama Nursery Co., stressing urgency to catch the seasonal harvest.
subfiles.title: Letter from Allen J. Hankele to U.S. State Department requesting procedure to order Japanese seeds

subfiles.about: The American Embassy in Cairo transmits an official request by the Egyptian Ministry of Agriculture for Japanese rice seed samples.
subfiles.from: American Embassy, Cairo, Egypt (drafted by R. B. Elwood)
subfiles.summary: Despatch No. 2670: Cairo forwards Egypt's Agriculture Ministry request for Japanese rice seed samples, received by State in July 1947 and circulated among regional divisions.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 2670 from American Embassy Cairo on Egyptian request for Japanese rice seed samples
